summary: Frontend-only verification of the receipt-only PDF sharing/download/print feature in ReceiptDialog.jsx. Logged in as Raj Mehta (+91 98765 42100 / RajSecure@2026), recorded a UPI collection of ₹123 with remark 'TEST_ReceiptPDF' against 'Urban Grocers · Nikhil Arora', which auto-opened the receipt modal (LFC-2607-0E491). Instrumented navigator.share / navigator.canShare / window.open / URL.createObjectURL via addInitScript to observe the exact File/Blob objects the buttons produce. Verified: (1) receipt modal shows receipt no, vendor, amount, mode, timestamp, employee, remarks, thank-you message and all 3 action buttons (data-testids receipt-whatsapp-share, receipt-download-button, receipt-print-button); (2) Share receipt PDF invokes navigator.share exactly once with title='LedgerFlow receipt' and files=[File] where name='LedgerFlow-LFC-2607-0E491.pdf', type='application/pdf', size=5139 bytes, and the file bytes start with the ASCII '%PDF-' header; (3) Download this receipt PDF triggers a browser download of the same-named 5139-byte application/pdf, captured by Playwright expect_download; (4) Print this receipt only calls window.open with a blob:URL whose backing Blob has type='application/pdf' and size=5139 bytes (identical to shared/downloaded PDF, confirming the same buildReceiptPdf() output is used) and then calls .print() on the opened window — no surrounding app UI is sent to print; (5) Simulated user-cancel of the native share sheet by making navigator.share throw AbortError → no unhandledrejection fired, no console error, UI remains usable; (6) Simulated Web Share API unsupported by deleting navigator.share → Share receipt PDF button gracefully falls back to downloading the same PDF (LedgerFlow-LFC-2607-0E491.pdf). Desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844 layouts both render the receipt modal cleanly — on mobile the dialog is 354px wide inside a 390px viewport (no horizontal overflow), and all three action buttons are stacked and fully visible. Code review of buildReceiptPdf confirms a single A5 portrait page (no addPage() call) with header, receipt number, amount, 4 mandatory + 1 optional detail rows, and a thank-you footer — matching the on-screen modal content exactly. All 6 acceptance criteria in the review request pass.
critical_code_review_comments: ReceiptDialog.buildReceiptPdf never calls addPage() and lays out fixed content within an A5 page — guaranteed single-page PDF. Good.

shareReceipt correctly swallows AbortError only (error.name === 'AbortError') and falls back to downloadReceipt() for every other failure path, so a cancelled share sheet never surfaces an error and an unsupported browser still gets the same PDF. Good.
printReceipt opens the generated blob URL in a new tab and calls print() on its load event, then revokes the object URL after 60s — this prints ONLY the receipt PDF, never the surrounding SPA. Good.
Minor (non-blocking): if popup blockers prevent window.open, printReceipt silently no-ops with no user feedback. Consider a toast fallback ('Allow popups to print, or use Download instead').
seed_data_creation: One additional collection row created via UI: vendor=ven-urban, amount=123, mode=UPI, remark='TEST_ReceiptPDF' (receipt LFC-2607-0E491). No new vendors created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Web Share API cannot be triggered natively in headless Chromium; test approach is to override navigator.share/canShare via page.add_init_script BEFORE navigation and record call args (title, files[0].name/type/size and the first bytes of the file). To assert 'receipt-only' printing, override window.open + URL.createObjectURL and confirm the printed blob's type=application/pdf and size matches the downloaded PDF. Playwright's page.expect_download works for both the explicit Download button and the fallback path when navigator.share is deleted. All data-testids used: receipt-dialog, receipt-number, receipt-amount, receipt-vendor, receipt-payment, receipt-datetime, receipt-employee, receipt-remarks, receipt-thanks-message, receipt-whatsapp-share, receipt-download-button, receipt-print-button.
rca of the issue: No defects found. Feature works exactly as specified: share/download/print all operate on a single buildReceiptPdf() output and never include surrounding app UI; AbortError is silently swallowed; unsupported Web Share falls back to download.
